dialect.detail: ACUCOBOL-GT / Micro Focus ACUCOBOL dialect: uses DISPLAY OMITTED BLANK SCREEN COLOR, SET CONFIGURATION 'DLL-CONVENTION', MB-OK/MB-ERROR-ICON message box syntax, C$MEMCPY, SIGNED-LONG, POINTER, and XFD (eXtended File Descriptor) file parsing — all characteristic of ACUCOBOL-GT runtime
evidence: display message box ... type is MB-OK, icon is MB-ERROR-ICON

purpose.domain_detail: XFD (eXtended File Descriptor) file parser test — reads an ACUCOBOL XFD metadata file, extracts field definitions, builds a CSV/text representation, computes an MD5 hash, and writes output to a JSON-named text file
purpose.summary: This program tests an XFD parser library by loading an XFD file for a data file, iterating over all field definitions, assembling field metadata into a delimited string, computing an MD5 hash of the result, and optionally writing the output to a file. It exercises several custom shared libraries (libmd5.so, libparsexfd.so) and ACUCOBOL runtime extensions.

notable_features: ACUCOBOL XFD file parsing via shared library (libparsexfd.so)
C$MEMCPY built-in for pointer-based memory copy
Dead code after STOP RUN (unreachable CALL statements)
STRING with X"00" null terminator for C interop
verdict.notes: The program has dead code after the first STOP RUN (several CALL statements and file I/O that are never reached). This appears to be a developer test/prototype for an XFD parsing utility, not production code. The filename 'parsetst1.cbl' and program-id 'PARSETST' confirm test intent. Brazilian Portuguese context suggested by variable names (AQRUIVO=arquivo, vendas, multidad).
